text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
*yawn*... Ugh... No good...
My eyes are getting all bleary...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh, it's so bitter~...
But if I add milk, it probably won't be as effective...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I wonder if this will really wake me up properly...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suffering from a lack of sleep, Kitasan Black
resorted to drinking coffee, which she wasn't fond of.
